reasoning_content:
All assets serve. Now let me verify integration renders. We don't have a browser. Could install a headless check? Let's at least verify the JS is intact by fetching. Also verify the php proxy exists (for reference).

Let me also confirm nginx running and maybe set up to start. Let me finalize with a check that the server root and all guide-required folders are in docroot.

Let me also verify the application can load fully — maybe use node? Not installed. Could try to check with curl and grep for content. Good enough.

Let me check whether there's a kosis data folder requirement. examples/kosis/data exists. Good.

I'll do final verification listing.

echo "=== data dirs ==="; find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type d -name data
echo "=== confirm content served ==="; curl -s http://localhost:8080/index.html | grep -c "Data Explorer"
